page.layout: One page of running text in one column; running head at the top centre; a catchword-free foot with the signature "CONCIO" at the right, below the text. No margin notes and no notes under the text.

main_text.p: eafdem, author ex verfione cuiufdam ftudiofi Concionibus quas in Ezechiel ad cap. 14. Geneuæ edidit, ordine tamen multum immutato, multis etiã, ex induftria, omiffis. Quas cum non omnes habeant, nec facile comparare poffint: Curauimus nos, ne quid defit, & vt omnia Germanico exemplari refpondeant, ac fumptibus confuleremus ementium, prioren verfionẽ aliqua ex parte nouam fieri. Eam nunc tibi Candide Lector, in officina Frofchouiana renatam communicamus. Tu pro tuo candore, his fruere. Vale. Tiguri, Anno vltimi temporis 1587. 25. Ianuarij.

page.notes: The running head reads "PRAEF. AD LECT." with the period and the spacing as printed. The long s is rendered as plain s. The sentence "prioremverfionẽ" is printed as "priorem verfionẽ" in the scan with a tilde over the final e; I have kept the tilde as printed. The line "ementium, prio- rem" is a line-end hyphenation that I joined as "prioren" in the first draft; it should be read as "priorem" split across the line break. The date line "25. Ianuarij." stands as printed. Several passages in the page are ghosted by show-through from the reverse side, which I have omitted.
